senses.definition: a name in Judah 1 Ch 4:11, 𝔊 Χαλεβ (according to WeCentib. 20, Hist. 218 = כָּלֵב בֶּן־חֶזְרוֹן; read also for כַּרְמִי v 1).
father of one of David’s officers, according to 1 Ch 27:26 (𝔊 Χοβουδ, A Χελουβ, 𝔊L Χαλουβ).
